name: Jean-Baptiste Camille Corot
description: French landscape and portrait painter and printmaker in etching (1796-1875)

summary.text: Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot, or simply Camille Corot, was a French landscape and portrait painter as well as a printmaker in etching.
summary.title: Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot

24283: The Bridge at Narni is an 1826 painting of the Ponte d'Augusto at Narni by French artist Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot. The painting is on display at the Musée du Louvre in Paris.
3221688: Le Concert Champêtre is an 1857 oil-on-canvas painting by French artist Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot, now in the Musée Condé of Chantilly, France. A reworking of a composition exhibited by Corot in the Salon of 1844, the painting was shown in the Salon of 1857.
5442918: A Woman Reading is an oil-on-canvas painting by French artist Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot, created in 1869. The painting is in the Metropolitan Museum of Art, in New York.
7571529: Souvenir de Mortefontaine is an oil-on-canvas painting by French artist Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot, created in 1864. It is a scene of tranquillity: a woman and children quietly enjoying themselves by a glass-flat, tree-flanked lake.
7920022: View of Venice: The Piazzetta Seen from the Riva degli Schiavoni is an oil-on-canvas painting of Venice executed c. 1835–1845 by French artist Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot. The painting is at the Norton Simon Museum in Pasadena, but as at 2026 not on display.
View of Venice: The Piazzetta Seen from the Riva degli Schiavoni
7931023: Ville-d’Avray is an 1865 oil painting by the French artist Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot. It is on display at the National Gallery of Art in Washington D.C.
15709546: Castel Sant'Angelo and the Tiber, Rome is an oil-on-canvas painting made by French artist Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot, between 1826 and 1828. Its a veduta which depicts the cityscape formed by the Castel Sant'Angelo and the Tiber River, in Rome, Italy.
Castel Sant'Angelo and the Tiber, Rome
17496028: The Dance of the Nymphs is an 1850 oil painting by the French artist Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot. A landscape, it displays a group of nymphs dancing in a wooded glen.
18177364: Macbeth and the Witches or simply Macbeth is an 1859 oil painting by the French artist Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot. It blends landscape and history painting in a scene inspired by William Shakespeare's tragedy Macbeth.
18177365: The Repose is an oil painting on canvas by the French artist Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot, from 1860. It is held at the National Gallery of Art, in Washington D.C..
18177483: Hagar in the Wilderness is an oil-on-canvas painting by the French artist Camille Corot, created in 1835. The picture was displayed at the Salon of 1835 held in Paris.
18177756: The Cathedral of Chartres is an oil painting on canvas of Chartres Cathedral by the French artist Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot, created in 1830. After being sold several times, it has been held in the Musée du Louvre, in Paris since 1906.
18177773: The Church of Marissel is an 1866 landscape painting by the French artist Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot. It features a view of village of Marissel near Beauvais in the department of Oise.
18177816: The Road from Sèvres, full title The Road from Sèvres.
18177917: Gypsy with Tambourine is an oil-on-canvas painting by French painter Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot. Executed c. 1862, it is now held in the collection of the Bank of the Republic and exhibited at the Museo Botero, in Bogotá.
18178062: Forest of Fontainebleau is an 1834 landscape painting by the French artist Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot. It depicts the Forest of Fontainebleau near Fontainebleau.
18178377: The Willows of Marissel is an 1857 landscape painting by the French artist Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot. It depicts a view near the village of Marissel in Oise with a couple, a child, and a dog walking through an avenue of willows and poplars.
18178495: The Harbor of La Rochelle is an oil-on-canvas painting by French artist Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot, created in 1851. It is held at the Yale University Art Gallery, in New Haven.
19905179: Sibylle is an oil-on-canvas painting by the French artist Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot, from c. 1870. It depicts a model holding a red rose.
20184292: Diana and Actaeon is an oil on canvas history painting by the French artist Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot, from 1836. It is held at the Metropolitan Museum of Art, in New York.
83742676: View of Volterra is an oil painting on canvas by French artist Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot, created in 1838. It is held at the Timken Museum of Art, in San Diego.
91034690: Richmond Near London is an 1862 landscape painting by the French artist Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot. While now part of Greater London, Richmond was then a town on the outskirts of the city.
